Here’s a **starter list of notable Sherlock Holmes movies**, grouped by era/actor. There are **many** adaptations, so this focuses on the best-known feature films.

## Classic / Early Sherlock Holmes Films
- **Sherlock Holmes Baffled** — 1900
- **Sherlock Holmes** — 1916, starring William Gillette
- **The Return of Sherlock Holmes** — 1929
- **The Hound of the Baskervilles** — 1939, starring Basil Rathbone
- **The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes** — 1939, starring Basil Rathbone

## Basil Rathbone Sherlock Holmes Series
- **The Hound of the Baskervilles** — 1939
- **The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes** — 1939
- **Sherlock Holmes and the Voice of Terror** — 1942
- **Sherlock Holmes and the Secret Weapon** — 1942
- **Sherlock Holmes in Washington** — 1943
- **Sherlock Holmes Faces Death** — 1943
- **The Spider Woman** — 1943
- **The Scarlet Claw** — 1944
- **The Pearl of Death** — 1944
- **The House of Fear** — 1945
- **The Woman in Green** — 1945
- **Pursuit to Algiers** — 1945
- **Terror by Night** — 1946
- **Dressed to Kill** — 1946

## Other Notable Sherlock Holmes Films
- **A Study in Terror** — 1965
- **The Private Life of Sherlock Holmes** — 1970
- **The Seven-Per-Cent Solution** — 1976
- **Murder by Decree** — 1979
- **Young Sherlock Holmes** — 1985
- **Without a Clue** — 1988
- **The Hound of the Baskervilles** — 2002
- **Sherlock Holmes and the Case of the Silk Stocking** — 2004
- **Sherlock Holmes** — 2010, TV film starring Ben Syder
- **Mr. Holmes** — 2015, starring Ian McKellen

## Robert Downey Jr. Sherlock Holmes Films
- **Sherlock Holmes** — 2009
- **Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows** — 2011

## Comedy / Family / Inspired Films
- **The Great Mouse Detective** — 1986
- **Sherlock Gnomes** — 2018
- **Holmes & Watson** — 2018
- **Enola Holmes** — 2020
- **Enola Holmes 2** — 2022

## Japanese / International
- **The Hound of the Baskervilles: Sherlock the Movie** — 2022, Japanese adaptation connected to the series *Sherlock: Untold Stories*

If you want, I can also make a **complete chronological list** of Sherlock Holmes movies from 1900 to present.
